product_overview: Applination is a self-hosted, AI-assisted job application pipeline for individual job seekers. It helps users discover, rank, tailor, and track job applications from a single web interface, while grounding generated content in their real resume, bio, and stories.
core_goals: Discover and review job opportunities from multiple sources
Run a pipeline that ranks jobs and generates tailored application materials
Manage applications through table, kanban, and detail views
Generate a tailored application for one specific job posting
Use an AI coach, mock interview, and essay drafter for application prep
Review past runs, compare outcomes, and view analytics
Edit master profile data and configuration used by the tailoring pipeline

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provides a landing page with key stats, recent activity, upcoming deadlines, and reminder options for the user's application workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View application and run summary cards -> Review recent runs and recent applications -> Check upcoming deadlines -> Download a calendar reminder file
Navigate to / -> View reminder options -> Request an email digest -> See reminder status feedback

features.name: Pipeline Run
features.description: Starts a full pipeline run and shows live progress as each stage completes.
user_flows: Navigate to /run -> Start a pipeline run -> Watch live progress updates for each stage -> Follow the run as jobs are processed -> See the run complete
Navigate to /run -> Start a pipeline run -> Watch progress updates -> Stop the run gracefully -> See the run end after the current job finishes

features.name: Applications List
features.description: Lets users browse applications in table or kanban form, search and filter them, update status in bulk, and sync recruiter replies from inbox sources.
user_flows: Navigate to /applications -> Browse applications in table view -> Search by company, role, or tag -> Filter by status -> Update one or more application statuses
Navigate to /applications -> Switch to kanban view -> Review applications grouped by status -> Move between statuses visually
Navigate to /applications -> Trigger inbox sync -> Wait for recruiter replies to be scanned -> Review updated inbox-linked application activity
Navigate to /applications -> Select multiple applications -> Apply a bulk status change -> See the selected rows update

features.name: Application Detail
features.description: Shows a single application's full record, including generated documents, notes, tags, deadlines, status, and version history for resume and cover letter edits.
user_flows: Navigate to /applications/1 -> Review the application details -> Open the resume version diff -> Inspect how the latest version changed
Navigate to /applications/1 -> Edit the cover letter text inline -> Save the updated draft -> Review the regenerated document version
Navigate to /applications/1 -> Update notes, tags, deadline, or status -> Observe changes persist on the application record
Navigate to /applications/1 -> Download the resume or cover letter documents -> Open the exported files
Navigate to /applications/1 -> View the job and resume raw data -> Return to the application record

features.name: Single Job Wizard
features.description: Guides the user through extracting one job posting, reviewing the extracted details, and generating tailored documents for that job.
user_flows: Navigate to /single -> Provide a job URL or paste job details manually -> Review extracted company, title, location, and description -> Generate tailored materials -> See the new application record and document links
Navigate to /single -> Skip URL extraction -> Enter job details manually -> Review and adjust the parsed fields -> Generate the job-specific application

features.name: Coach Chat
features.description: Offers a profile-grounded assistant for career coaching, application guidance, and grounded conversation tied to a specific application.
user_flows: Navigate to /coach -> Start a new coaching conversation -> Ask a career or application question -> Receive a grounded response based on the user's profile
Navigate to /coach -> Select a specific application as context -> Ask for help with that job -> Receive advice grounded in the selected role and company
Navigate to /coach -> Save a strong assistant response to the answer bank -> Reuse it later for application materials

features.name: Mock Interview
features.description: Runs a structured mock interview one question at a time, giving coached feedback and a model answer after each response.
user_flows: Navigate to /interview -> Start a mock interview session -> Answer the first question -> Receive feedback, a model answer, and the next question -> Continue through the interview

features.name: Essay Drafter
features.description: Generates a grounded essay draft from a prompt, with optional limits and instructions.
user_flows: Navigate to /essay -> Enter an essay prompt -> Add optional word-limit or instructions -> Generate a draft -> Review the completed essay

features.name: Runs History
features.description: Displays a list of previous pipeline runs with status and timing information.
user_flows: Navigate to /runs -> Review the list of past runs -> Compare run statuses and durations -> Open a run for more detail

features.name: Run Detail and Ranked Triage
features.description: Shows the details of a specific run, including event timeline, logs, and a ranked-job triage view for rescuing or dismissing jobs.
user_flows: Navigate to /runs/1 -> Review the run timeline and logs -> Open the ranked jobs triage view -> Filter the pool by selection status -> Rescue a non-selected job for generation
Navigate to /runs/1 -> Review the ranked pool -> Dismiss a job from future runs -> See the job removed from future triage

features.name: Run Compare
features.description: Lets users compare two pipeline runs side by side on outcome metrics and application differences.
user_flows: Navigate to /runs/compare -> Select two runs -> Compare score and application metrics -> Review shared and unique companies between runs

features.name: Stats
features.description: Provides analytics charts for application outcomes, source breakdowns, and match-score distributions.
user_flows: Navigate to /stats -> Review the analytics charts -> Inspect application status trends -> Review score distribution and throughput

features.name: Config Editor
features.description: Allows editing the raw configuration and checking provider connectivity from within the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /config -> Review the current configuration file -> Edit configuration values -> Save the updated config -> Run provider connectivity tests -> Review connectivity results

features.name: Workflows Editor
features.description: Lets users assign providers and models to individual LLM tasks through a visual routing editor.
user_flows: Navigate to /workflows -> Review the routing for each workflow task -> Change a task's provider or model assignment -> Save the routing configuration -> Inspect the updated task chain

features.name: Master Data Editor
features.description: Supports editing resume, bio, and stories content with AI assistance for improving the candidate profile material.
user_flows: Navigate to /master-data -> Open the resume, bio, or stories tab -> Edit the source content or request AI assistance -> Generate an improved draft -> Review and save the updated content
Navigate to /master-data -> Start a new story from a description -> Generate a structured story draft -> Review the frontmatter and narrative text -> Save the story

known_limitations.issue: Dev server limits TestSprite to 15 high-priority tests
known_limitations.impact: Full coverage requires a production build (npm run build and npm run start), which caps at 30.

known_limitations.issue: No authentication layer; all pages are open
Several actions trigger expensive or outward-facing backend calls
known_limitations.impact: During this session LLM keys are blanked and no Gmail creds are set, so start-run errors in the background and inbox/digest actions surface a not-configured error toast. Tests should assert UI rendering and interaction wiring, not real run/email outcomes.
